description: This file defines the 'PagedLocalRequest' class, a specialized request object extending 'PagedRequest' with additional locale and format settings for localizing data retrieval.

classes.name: PagedLocalRequest
classes.description: A Java class that extends 'PagedRequest' to include local-specific parameters such as date format, date-time format, and locale settings. It provides methods for retrieving locale as a Locale object and overrides 'equals' and 'hashCode' for proper object comparison.

methods.name: getLocaleObject
methods.description: Returns the locale as a Locale object parsed from the stored locale string using 'JsonParserHelper.localeFromString'.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides the default 'equals' method to compare 'PagedLocalRequest' objects, including additional fields for locale and format.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides 'hashCode' to include fields from 'PagedLocalRequest' along with its superclass.
